# Tulip File Explorer

> Tulip File Explorer is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop file manager for Windows, Linux and macOS, built with Electron and React by Atish Ak Sharma. Current version: 1.4.3-2.

## Features

- Light and dark themes, and eight accent colours (Ocean Blue, Royal Purple, Rose Pink, Crimson Red, Sunset Orange, Forest Green, Ocean Teal, Deep Indigo)
- This PC view: libraries (Home, Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Videos, Music) and every drive with a free-space bar
- Preview pane: plays videos and shows photos in place, with size, modified date, duration, resolution and codec
- Clickable breadcrumb path bar, back / forward / up / refresh
- Search inside the current folder
- Grid and list views, sorting, show or hide hidden files
- Add cloud drives next to local disks
